title: Explain engineering authoring and correction steps
description: Explain the semantic steps, governing rules, expected outcomes, and correction paths for the selected authoring activity. This behavior helps participants reason about definitions; record retention, validation execution, and permission decisions have separate owners.
inputs: Selected activity, applicable canonical guidance, and author-provided engineering context.
Existing definitions and identifiable review or validation findings when correction is requested.
Known authority limits and declared representation support.
preconditions: Applicable guidance is identifiable, or its absence is exposed before a conformance claim.
outputs: Activity-specific guidance with rule explanations, expected semantic outcomes, and applicable checks.
Explicit unresolved decisions, unsupported representation scope, and actions requiring separate authority.
behavior: Explain requirement analysis and single-parent derivation, black-box Scenario analysis, system capability and behavior definitions, and architecture responsibility as appropriate to the requested activity.
For architecture tasks, explain consistent AR/Function allocation and explicit interaction providers/consumers without implying that undeclared record formats exist.
Connect naming, relationship, correction, and retirement steps to their canonical rules and current affected definitions.
Explain identifiable diagnostics and how a proposed correction can be checked without treating the diagnostic itself as an editing authorization.
Select one consequential clarification at a time when necessary, retaining uncertainty and refraining from invented answers.
Distinguish a recommendation, a conformant record, an approved change, and a satisfied requirement.

failure_behavior.condition: Required context or an engineering decision is unresolved.
failure_behavior.outcome: Describe the dependency and the highest-value clarification needed; do not present dependent conclusions as settled.

failure_behavior.condition: A record type has no declared authoring representation or an action exceeds authority.
failure_behavior.outcome: Explain the available conceptual guidance and the unsupported or separately authorized action without claiming conformance or permission.

sources.basis: SR-033 establishes bounded, explainable authoring and correction guidance across the declared REM activities.

Propose MOD-008 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
